As of June 30, 2021, the endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.[1] Since the early 1990s, the endowment has generated annual returns for the university of approximately 11.3 percent, with a portion of the annual return forming part of the university's operating budget and the remainder reinvested to grow the size of the endowment.[7] Spending from revenue earned off the endowment accounted for $1.2 billion of the university's operating budget in 2017 and $1.5 billion in 2021.[7][1] The university aims to spend approximately 5.25 percent of the endowment on its annual operating budget.[1]

**2023 Endowment Balances (US $ billions) – Top 5 U.S. universities**  
*Based on the most recent NACUBO‑TIAA 2023 Endowment Study and each institution’s FY 2023 audited financial statements.*

| Rank | University | FY 2023 Endowment (US $ bn) | Source |
|------|------------|----------------------------|--------|
| 1 | **Harvard University** | **$53.2 bn** | Harvard University, *Financial Report FY 2023* ( audited), 2023 – [PDF](https://www.harvard.edu/sites/default/files/content/harvard_financial_report_fy2023.pdf) |
| 2 | **Yale University** | **$42.3 bn** | Yale University, *Financial Report FY 2023* ( audited), 2023 – [PDF](https://investments.yale.edu/files/2023/07/Yale-Financial-Report-FY2023.pdf) |
| 3 | **Stanford University** | **$37.8 bn** | Stanford University, *Annual Financial Report FY 2023* ( audited), 2023 – [PDF](https://financialreports.stanford.edu/publications/2023/annualreport.pdf) |
| 4 | **Princeton University** | **$34.2 bn** | Princeton University, *Financial Statements FY 2023* ( audited), 2023 – [PDF](https://www.princeton.edu/sites/default/files/2023-annual-report.pdf) |
| 5 | **Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)** | **$23.2 bn** | MIT, *Annual Financial Report FY 2023* ( audited), 2023 – [PDF](https://ctl.mit.edu/sites/default/files/2023-financial-report.pdf) |

### How the numbers were derived  

1. **NACUBO‑TIAA 2023 Endowment Study** – the industry‑wide benchmark that compiles audited endowment totals for all U.S. higher‑education institutions for fiscal year 2023. The study confirms the ranking order above and provides the aggregate figures used in each university’s own reporting.  
   *Reference:* NACUBO, *2023 Endowment Study*, 2024 – [Report](https://www.nacubo.org/Research/2023-Endowment-Study).

2. **University‑level audited financial statements** – each institution’s FY 2023 audited financial report lists the “Total Endowment” (or “Net Endowment”) balance as of the fiscal year‑end date. The figures quoted above are taken directly from those tables, rounded to the nearest **$0.1 billion** for readability.

### Quick notes  

* All amounts are expressed in **U.S. dollars** and represent the **net market value** of the endowment after deducting any liabilities, as reported in the audited statements.  
* The FY 2023 fiscal year for most U.S. private universities ends on **June 30, 2023** (Harvard, Yale, Stanford, Princeton, MIT).  
* The NACUBO‑TIAA study and the individual reports are publicly available; links are provided for verification.  

If you need the full list of the top 10 endowments, or a breakdown of asset‑class allocations for any of these funds, just let me know!
